g.text: KESTREL K1 — Medial thigh plate, Mk II (full-circle hip boss, H4)
Material: 7075-T651 30 mm plate · Process: 5-axis CNC (jogged plate)
Tolerances: 12x Ø5.5 cbore Ø9.5x5 on PCD 105 ±0.02; spigot Ø90 H7; 2x Ø6 H7 dowels; 7207 BE seat Ø72 H6 · Finish: hard anodise black
Dimension from the STEP model; general tolerances per docs/09 §2. Break sharp edges 0.2–0.5 mm. Projection: isometric, hidden lines grey.
